ir.name: loss_pairwise_advantage_ranked_weighted_ce_repaired
ir.intuition: Numerically stable weighted cross-entropy on pairwise advantage gap with sigmoid link applied to log_prob difference, clipping logits to avoid extreme values.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
weight = batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))
margin = clamp(lpw - lpl, min=-50, max=50)
prob = sigmoid(margin)
log_prob = log(prob.clamp(min=eps))
loss = -abs(adv_gap) * log_prob * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin = ops.clamp(margin, -50.0, 50.0)
    prob = ops.sigmoid(margin)
    log_prob = ops.log(ops.clamp(prob, eps, 1.0))
    loss = ops.neg(ops.mul(ops.abs(advantage_gap), log_prob))
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
